overall: The posts are rally and endorsement messages without policy or economic content, so they are unlikely to affect market sentiment or specific stocks at this time.

findings.post: Trump claims strong majority support for stopping Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons
findings.why: A political stance on Iran's nuclear program could boost expectations of higher U.S. defense spending and potential sanctions, lifting defense sector stocks.

findings.post: Announced a free shipment of one million barrels of Venezuelan oil to the US, promising billions more and energy dominance
findings.why: A large, cost‑free oil import could lower fuel prices and boost demand for energy equipment makers like GE, modestly supporting their stock
